segment.source: Place application-owned buttons in the title bar LeftAddOn/RightAddOn areas using WindowTitleBarButton and WindowTitleBarToggleButton.
segment.target: 透過 WindowTitleBarButton 與 WindowTitleBarToggleButton 在標題列的 LeftAddOn/RightAddOn 擴充區放置應用自訂按鈕。

segment.source: The left add-on hosts a menu button and a pin toggle; the right add-on hosts search and settings buttons.
segment.target: 左側擴充區提供選單按鈕與圖釘開關；右側擴充區提供搜尋與設定按鈕。
開啟擴充區視窗
標題列擴充區

segment.source: The default Window shape: title, three caption buttons and standard interactions, as the baseline for other demos.
segment.target: 預設標題列形態：標題、三鍵 caption 與標準互動，作為其他示例的對照基線。
開啟基礎視窗
基礎視窗

segment.source: This is the default look of an AtomUI Window. The title bar shows the title together with the standard caption buttons.
segment.target: 這是 AtomUI Window 的預設形態：標題列顯示標題與標準 caption 按鈕。

segment.source: Compose the caption button set: hide the minimize button and show the full screen and pin buttons.
segment.target: 自訂系統按鈕組合：隱藏最小化按鈕，顯示全螢幕與圖釘按鈕。

segment.source: Only full screen and pin buttons remain on the right of the title bar; minimizing is disabled for this window.
segment.target: 標題列右側僅保留全螢幕與圖釘按鈕；該視窗已停用最小化。
開啟按鈕自訂視窗
標題列按鈕自訂
一般
穩定

segment.source: Customize TitleBarFrameBackground, ContentFrameBackground and a decorative WindowFrameLayer with opacity.
segment.target: 自訂 TitleBarFrameBackground、ContentFrameBackground 以及帶透明度的裝飾性 WindowFrameLayer。

segment.source: The title bar uses a gradient, the content area a brand tint, and a corner-decorated layer floats above them.
segment.target: 標題列使用漸層色，內容區使用品牌淺色，裝飾層帶圓角懸浮其上。
開啟窗框層視窗
窗框層自訂

segment.source: IsTitleVisible=False hides only the title text inside the title bar; the taskbar and window switching still show the OS window title. Different from IsTitleBarVisible, which hides the whole title bar.
segment.target: IsTitleVisible=False 僅隱藏標題列內的標題文字，工作列與視窗切換仍顯示系統標題；與 IsTitleBarVisible（隱藏整條標題列）區分。

segment.source: The title bar shows no title text, but the taskbar still shows "AtomUI Demo".
segment.target: 標題列內沒有標題文字，但工作列仍顯示 "AtomUI Demo"。
開啟隱藏標題視窗
隱藏標題文字

segment.source: Switch the Logo display policy between Auto, Always and Never.
segment.target: 在 Auto、Always 與 Never 之間切換 Logo 顯示策略。

segment.source: Switch the segmented control below and watch the Logo visibility change.
segment.target: 切換下方選項，觀察 Logo 顯示變化。
開啟 Logo 策略視窗
Logo 顯示策略

segment.source: Explore Window title bar content, window chrome and frame layer customization.
segment.target: 展示 AtomUI Window 的標題列內容、視窗形態與背景層定製能力。
視窗與標題列定製。

segment.source: On macOS the system traffic lights are native: the minimize, maximize and full screen switches apply to the AtomUI-drawn buttons on Windows/Linux; only the pin switch takes effect here.
segment.target: macOS 使用系統原生紅綠燈按鈕：最小化/最大化/全螢幕開關作用於 Windows/Linux 的自繪按鈕，在本平台僅圖釘開關生效。

segment.source: A live window combining every option on this page: title text, alignment, logo policy, add-ons, caption buttons and frame backgrounds.
segment.target: 一個組合本頁全部選項的即時視窗：標題文字、對齊方式、Logo 策略、擴充區、系統按鈕與窗框背景。

segment.source: The panel on the right acts on this window's title bar and frame in real time.
segment.target: 右側面板即時作用於本視窗的標題列與窗框。
開啟 Playground
綜合 Playground

segment.source: Switch the title group alignment between Auto, Left, Center, WindowCenter and Right.
segment.target: 在 Auto、Left、Center、WindowCenter 與 Right 之間切換標題組對齊。

segment.source: Switch the segmented control below and watch the title group alignment change.
segment.target: 切換下方選項，觀察標題組對齊變化。
開啟對齊演示視窗
標題對齊

segment.source: IsTitleBarVisible=False removes the built-in title bar; a custom header row and an embedded WindowTitleBar keep dragging and double-click maximize working.
segment.target: IsTitleBarVisible=False 移除內建標題列；自繪頭部列與內嵌 WindowTitleBar 仍可拖動視窗、雙擊最大化。

segment.source: The top area is fully custom. The embedded title bar still supports dragging and double-click to maximize.
segment.target: 頂部區域完全自訂。內嵌標題列仍支援拖動與雙擊最大化。
開啟無標題列視窗
無標題列視窗
